title: Trust these hooks?
body: Once trusted, these hooks run on {{computer}}, as you, each time their event happens.
none: The agent lists no hook commands for this set.
risk: The agent cannot check these files or addresses. Whatever they hold when a hook runs, runs too.
hidden: A command or address here holds characters a screen would hide or change. Each is shown marked, like ⟨ESC⟩ or ⟨U+200B⟩: check the exact text above before trusting, because that text is what runs.
hiddenSeen: I have read the exact text, marks included
toolong: A command or address here is too long to show whole, so this set cannot be trusted from this page.
